subject.name: Saint Teresa of Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church
subject.blurb: Spanish Carmelite who reformed her order into the Discalced Carmelites against determined opposition, founding seventeen houses in twenty years while writing The Interior Castle and the Life. In 1970 she became the first woman named a Doctor of the Church.
subject.notification: St. Teresa of Ávila, pray for us!
